General Knowledge 2016-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2016-II.question: The headquarters of 'Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific' is located at
General Knowledge 2016-II.explanation: (c)  The Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (ESCAP) is the regional development arm of the United Nations for the Asia-Pacific region. It is a conglomerate of 53 Member States and 9 Associate Members. The headquarters of ESCAP is in Bangkok.

General Knowledge 2016-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2016-II.question: Which of the following with regard to the term 'bank run' is correct?
options: The net balance of money a bank has in its chest at the end of the day's business
The ratio of bank's total deposits and total liabilities
A panic situation when the deposit holders start withdrawing cash from the banks
The period in which a bank creates highest credit in the market Economics 228
General Knowledge 2016-II.answer: A panic situation when the deposit holders start withdrawing cash from the banks
General Knowledge 2016-II.explanation: (c)  A bank run occurs when a large number of customers of a bank or another financial institution withdraw their deposits simultaneously due to concerns about the bank's solvency. The panic situation arises when depositors withdraw their part fearing that the bank will be unable to repay their deposits in full and on time,

General Knowledge 2016-II.question: Which of the following will be the outcome if an economy is under the inflationary pressure?
General Knowledge 2016-II.explanation: (c)  If an economy is under inflationary pressure the most likely effects include the depreciation of domestic currencies and the cost of borrowing also decreases.

General Knowledge 2016-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2016-II.question: According to the Classical Theory of Employment, deviations from the state of full employment are
General Knowledge 2016-II.explanation: (a)  Full employment is the employment level at which every individual who desires to work at the existing wage rate gets employed. If the condition of unemployment occurs, it is a temporary/abnormal condition in the economy.

General Knowledge 2016-II.question: Capital deepening refers to
options: going for more fixed capital per worker
General Knowledge 2016-II.explanation: (d)  Capital Deepening is the process of increasing the amount of capital per worker.

General Knowledge 2016-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2016-II.question: Which one of the following statements is not correct?
options: Creation of National Investment and Infrastructure Fund (NIIF) was announced in the Union Budget, 2015-16.
NIIF is a fund for enhancing infrastructure facility in the country.
NIIF and NIF (National Investment Fund) are the names of the same organization,
NIIF can have more than one alternative investment fund,
General Knowledge 2016-II.answer: NIIF and NIF (National Investment Fund) are the names of the same organization,
General Knowledge 2016-II.explanation: (c)  The purpose of the National Investment Fund (NIF) is related to disinvestment proceedings of central public sector enterprises and to invest the same to generate earnings without depleting the corpus. National Investment and Infrastructure Fund (NIIF) is a fund created by the Government of India for enhancing infrastructure financing in the country.

General Knowledge 2016-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2016-II.question: Which one of the following statements is correct with respect to the composition of national income in India?
options: The share of manufacturing sector has declined.
The share of services sector has increased sharply.
The share of agriculture has remained static.
The share of services sector has declined.
General Knowledge 2016-II.answer: The share of services sector has increased sharply.
General Knowledge 2016-II.explanation: (b)  The contribution of Services Sector of India to overall GDP has increased sharply, from 41% in 1990-91 to 66% in 2014-15.

General Knowledge 2016-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2016-II.question: In India, the term 'hot money' is used to refer to
General Knowledge 2016-II.explanation: (d)  Hot money is cash that investors from foreign countries will invest during the short term in search of the highest interest rate possible. With the opening up of debt and equity markets to foreign portfolio investors, the FPI (Foreign Portfolio Investment) has emerged as the leading form of quick money flows globally.
